M is the midpoint of side BC, so M lies on segment BC.
The angles AMB and AMC together make a straight angle of 180 degrees.
The three interior angles of any triangle add to 180 degrees.
Prove that AM is perpendicular to BC, and find angle BAM.
target: AM is perpendicular to BC and angle BAM is 25 degrees.
